# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This directory contains GitHub Copilot configuration files for the Gencodo project.

## Files

- **`copilot-instructions.md`**: Main project-specific instructions automatically used by GitHub Copilot when working in this repository. Contains architectural details, development workflows, testing patterns, and coding conventions specific to Gencodo.

- **`personas/`**: Role-based instruction prompts for different SDLC personas. Reference these in your prompts for role-specific guidance (e.g., "As a developer, help me..." or "From a QA perspective, review...").

## Quick Start

GitHub Copilot automatically uses `copilot-instructions.md` - no configuration needed. For persona-based guidance, see the [`personas/`](personas/) directory.
